beta_new: Start by stepping off a neighbouring boulder, then clip a trio of bolts up the face on the far-right line.
Go straight up beyond the first bolt of Cling Peaches. A second bolt and some marginal nuts are all the protection on this long single pitch.
Two bolts guard the lower face; swing left of the shrubbery and carry on higher to a shelf, where the rap anchor sits on the right.
Ascend the face directly, clipping a lone bolt, to reach a good crack; shift left, then climb vertically and pull the overhang to finish.
Climb the opening face with two bolts for protection, then shuffle hand-over-hand along that flake until a bolt. Work rightward and upward into an overhanging corner and carry on to the top.
Three bolts protect the climbing, beginning from the black stretch of wall.
Begin in the big corner facing left, clip the bolt, then angle up leftward across plates and reach a belay ledge.
Start in a flake facing right beside a tree, climb it, then work up the grainy wall past a bolt that has no hanger, reaching a top with a rap anchor.
Three bolts lead you straight up the southeast face of the pinnacle.
Trace a row of bolts into a corner that faces left, then work leftward and up to finish.

Climb the crack and chimney leaving the alcove, clipping bolts and adding nuts and cams; after leaving the chimney, move right past a last bolt to the anchors. It can be climbed first to rig a top rope on the neighbouring route.
Begin atop a block and follow a thin crack until a bolt, then continue up a ramp system that leans rightward.
The leftmost of the formation's two lines, protected by a pair of bolts, it works its way up past several horizontal cracks.
Beginning alongside the tree, climb the leaning wall; seven bolts run up to the lower-off shuts, so the climbing is fully clipped.
Start from the notch located above the ledges you traverse in on, trend left, and follow a subtle groove with bolts.

Just three bolts protect it. The crux comes immediately after clip one, after which the angle backs off. A blocky slab sits shortly below the top: the left side gives the gentler exit, whereas the right side offers a brief, mildly runout alternative.
A low bolt covers the opening moves; farther up, trend right past a further bolt and onto the summit.
Launch from a block located twenty feet from Luminous Breast, clip a bolt, then trend up and leftward to merge with Ripples.
Stay along the formation's right-hand margin and clip all three bolts.
A three-bolt line up a slab streaked with black rock that gets steeper toward the top.
Begin in a little chimney, climbing four bolts in all. Past the second, step rightward to find stopper placements, then angle up-left toward bolt three.
Reach the first bolt by moving in sideways, coming from the left side.
Begin on the face's left side, mantel up and rightward onto a horizontal ledge, then climb a shallow depression past three bolts.
Flaky cracks lead upward; clip the bolt close to the finish, then move leftward and top out.
Starting well to the right of Terrorist, clip a bolt and move into the right-facing corners above.
It can be run as a single very long pitch, or broken at a bolted belay roughly forty feet up.
Gain the ledge used by Two Stage, then step rightward to this line and follow its bolts and pin.
Start near the ledge's left end, pull a minuscule roof, clip a bolt, and keep going to the one-bolt belay near the summit.
Glide up and leftward alongside a slanting crack. A cam around half-size fits the crack; otherwise skip it and keep going without protection until the first bolt.
Clip the single bolt and finish up a crack that has bushes growing in it.
Begin below and rightward of Casual Affair, mantel across a roof, then climb past a pin and a bolt.
Follow the big dihedral that faces left and marks the wall's far edge. It is a strenuous line that takes gear poorly, and the finish is an awkward mantel.
Scramble from the left onto the ledge at the base, passing a big tree, and climb the plated face on bolts.
Climb a crack through ribbed, grippy rock to technical yet well-protected moves; seven bolts lead to the chains.

Start in a shallow corner with fixed pins, place a medium cam into a pocket, and angle upward and leftward to a comfortable stance at the southeast arete. Clip a bolt, step across onto the principal face, and trend up and rightward past two bolts to a fixed pin lodged in a slim crack. Finally go left to an obvious pocket taking a big cam.
Once above the chimney, take the ramp up and rightward past the pin.

moves.from: Protection calls for medium and large cams.

beta_new: Climb leftward on sound rock past the one bolt, then from the shoulder move left into a second chute, then ascend it as far as the upper shoulder. Finish by scrambling up and leftward.
Begin the way Lascivious Conduct does, then hand-traverse rightward and follow broken cracks up to the anchor bolts.
Share the first ten feet with Crack Kills; step off rightward there and go up clipping four bolts.
Four bolts lead to the anchor Kola also uses; the first bolt sits close to twenty feet off the ground, so the opening moves are committing.
